allReviewedPassages.rawText: `readLedger` now selects the ledger transport, successful Git landing observation, and successful complete review revision pair independently after its one bounded retry. The retry's successful source is preferred when both attempts succeed. A successful empty Git list is retained, and no failed attempt's `landedError` or `reviewError` is attached to a retained successful source. Review base/head must come together from one successful capture and pass the existing full-commit shape check; opposite partial captures cannot create a review source. Failed ledger/Git/review attempts, including null dispatches, remain labelled source gaps. Finish's `metricsEvidence.gaps` includes those retained observations from both Resume and Finish reads.

allReviewedPassages.rawText: The replay covers ledger recovery and repeated ledger failure independently from Git/review success, failures alternating in both directions, opposite half revision pairs, a partial retry following a complete capture, a complete retry following a partial capture, and a null retry following successful empty Git/review capture. The Git fixture uses `bd-999` so fallback to this invocation's confirmed `bd-101` cannot satisfy the assertion. Review assertions inspect the dispatched immutable capture, rather than merely the presence of response fields. Existing assertions were not changed, removed, skipped or loosened.

RED, unchanged coordinator, exact new scenario extracted into a disposable `tests/super-code/.retry-replay.mjs`: same environment prefix followed by `node tests/super-code/.retry-replay.mjs`; exit 1, `26 passed, 13 failed`. [FAIL] ledger stays unavailable; first Git and review succeed: successful Git source survives without a failed attempt error
```text
[FAIL] both independent sources recover with unavailable ledger: successful Git source survives without a failed attempt error
[FAIL] opposite half pairs: no mixed-attempt review pair
[FAIL] partial retry after complete capture: no mixed-attempt review pair
26 passed, 13 failed
```
